proposed.text: An auditorium has a computed occupant load of 650 persons. Under PD 1096 Rule XII, Sec. 1202, how many exits are required, and what is the minimum aggregate exit width using the Code's exit width formula?

options.text: 2 exits; aggregate exit width = 650 ÷ 165 ≈ 3.94 width units because OL is under 1,000
4 exits; aggregate exit width = 650 ÷ 165 ≈ 3.94 width units because OL exceeds 500

3 exits; aggregate exit width = 650 ÷ 300 ≈ 2.17 width units per the Code's assembly formula

proposed.explanation: This question tests both the exit count brackets (2 exits for OL ≤ 499 above 1st floor; 3 exits for OL 500–999; 4 exits for OL ≥ 1,000) and the exit width formula (OL ÷ 165).
